## Processing All Practices Dynamically

This workflow:
1. Groups automations by practice
2. Sends ALL SMS through centralized gateway
3. Sends emails through practice-specific Gmail
4. Handles unlimited practices
5. Processes SMS and Email in parallel

centralized gateway
